trap.label: descrever festa (passiva)
trap.wrong: Carnival celebrates in Brazil. It is colorful and loud. I would love going.
trap.right: Carnival is celebrated in Brazil. It is colorful and loud. I would love to go.
trap.why: Em português “Carnaval se celebra no Brasil” e “adoraria ir” usam se e infinitivo. Em inglês, passiva com be; would love + to.

fix.right: The festival is celebrated every year.
I would love to visit Rio.

rewrite.prompt: Passe para a passiva: “People celebrate Carnival in Brazil.”
Reescreva: “I want to go.” (muito, educado: would love)
Passe para a passiva: “They hold the parade in Rio.”
rewrite.answer: The parade is held in Rio.
